parameters.name: AccessRegionIds
parameters.description: The list of region IDs that access the cloud service.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the cloud service.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description:
The IP address or CIDR block of the cloud service.

> Cloud services typically use multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks. Call this operation repeatedly to add all IP addresses or CIDR blocks of the cloud service.

parameters.name: HostRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the cloud service.

parameters.name: HostVpcId
parameters.description: The VPC-connected instance ID associated with the cloud service.
